description: Housing insurance policies and their coverage limits, deductible, add-ons and premium. One row per policy term.

columns.name: policy_id
columns.description: Unique identifier of the policy (format POL####). Primary key; referenced by policy_claims.policy_id.

columns.name: owner_id
columns.description: Owner of the policy. Foreign key to policy_owner.owner_id. One owner can hold several policies.

columns.name: policy_type
columns.description: Standard homeowners form: HO-3 Standard (open-peril dwelling), HO-5 Premium (open-peril dwelling and contents), HO-6 Condo, HO-4 Renters (contents only, no dwelling), DP-3 Dwelling (landlord / non-owner-occupied).

columns.name: property_address
columns.description: Street address of the insured property. Usually the owner's address, but can be a second property.

columns.name: property_state
columns.description: Two-letter US state code of the insured property. Drives state-specific rating and regulation.

columns.name: year_built
columns.description: Year the insured dwelling was constructed. Older homes typically carry higher risk.

columns.name: construction_type
columns.description: Primary construction material of the dwelling (Wood Frame, Brick, Masonry, Concrete, Steel Frame). Affects fire and wind risk.

columns.name: dwelling_coverage
columns.description: Coverage A limit in USD: maximum payout to repair or rebuild the structure. 0 for HO-4 Renters policies.

columns.name: personal_property_coverage
columns.description: Coverage C limit in USD: maximum payout for belongings and contents.

columns.name: liability_coverage
columns.description: Coverage E limit in USD: maximum payout for third-party bodily injury or property damage the owner is liable for.

columns.name: deductible
columns.description: Amount in USD the owner pays per claim before insurance pays. Higher deductible lowers the premium.

columns.name: flood_coverage
columns.description: Whether the optional flood endorsement is included (Y/N). Flood is excluded from standard policies.

columns.name: earthquake_coverage
columns.description: Whether the optional earthquake endorsement is included (Y/N).

columns.name: annual_premium
columns.description: Total yearly premium charged for the policy in USD.

columns.name: end_date
columns.description: Expiration date when coverage ends (YYYY-MM-DD). Policies are 12-month terms.

columns.name: status
columns.description: Current policy state: Active (in force), Renewed (term ended and was renewed), Expired (ended without renewal), Cancelled (terminated before end_date).
